column1: # Nudi B-Akshara glyph table: NudiB-Akshar and Nudi B-Akshara, the bilingual Nudi
# font, which draws Latin letters and digits at the ASCII codes and Kannada from 81 up.
# The format is described in src/legacy/table.rs. Codes are Windows-1252 bytes; 81, a
# code Windows-1252 leaves undefined, stands for itself.
# Derived from documents, as no code page is published. The glyphs were rendered from
# the TrueType subsets of the font embedded in public PDFs, all fetched from the
# - the 13th Karnataka Legislative Assembly's member pages on kla.kar.nic.in
#   with PScript5 and Ghostscript 8.15 in October 2011. Ghostscript dropped the font's
#   name and renumbered its codes, but kept glyph names (currency, Eth, c129 and so on)
#   that give each glyph's original code.
# - 18 Karnataka budget papers of 2007 to 2014 on kar.nic.in/finance and 4 Assembly
#   papers that name the font NudiB-Akshar, such as the 2011 budget speech
#   bspkan2011.pdf. Its subset has the same
#   outline as the member pages' font at 78 of the 82 codes both use.
# Each glyph was identified by eye, then checked in context: the text of the member
# pages and of 10,214 distinct lines of the budget papers was converted, and every
# unknown glyph and malformed syllable was read against the codes rendered with the
# embedded glyphs. docs/nudi-b.md has the method and results.
# 8F (ಓ) and 9D (ಛ) were read from the words they appear in (ಓದುವ, ಓವರ್; ಕಛೇರಿ,
# ಛಾಯಾಚಿತ್ರ), as no embedded subset holds them. Codes no document used are left out,
# Many PDFs, made with Acrobat Distiller or an Oracle PDF driver, have no glyph for code
# 81, which Windows-1252 leaves undefined, and write a space for it, so ಯ shows without
# its circle after a gap, inside a word as at its start. After a syllable the space
# is read as the lost circle; elsewhere the rest of the glyph still reads as ಯ.
# Latin letters, drawn as themselves: the font sets English and Kannada.
